# Rebinder

> Rebinder is an open-source Rust CLI for cross-harness session continuity between coding agents.

Claude-to-Codex transfer is operational for local Claude Code sessions detected by the installed Codex app-server. `rebinder sessions claude` lists source IDs, recorded workspaces, sizes, recommended strategies, and completed handoff bindings. `rebinder transfer --from claude --to codex` opens an interactive selector; an explicit session ID bypasses it. The default auto strategy fully imports sources up to 512 KiB and injects a bounded compact-summary checkpoint into a native Codex thread for larger sources. Repeat handoffs reuse the strategy-specific binding and inject a checkpoint only when the source changes. Rebinder leaves provider setup unchanged and fails closed when the workspace is missing. Codex-to-Claude transfer, missing-worktree reconstruction, and general compatibility reporting remain pending. The portable package validator and native command facades remain available independently.

- [Project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/README.md): Installation, CLI usage, current boundaries, release identity, and development commands.
- [Product requirements](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/product/product-requirements.md): Product behavior, user model, requirements, and constraints.
- [MVP status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/product/mvp-status.md): Operational Claude-to-Codex behavior and pending portability work.
- [Terminology](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/terminology.md): Canonical project language.

## Architecture and format

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/architecture/architecture.md): Component boundaries and the intended transfer pipeline.
- [Interchange Format 0.1.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/format/interchange-format-0.1.md): Canonical portable session package and validation rules.
- [CLI command model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/decisions/ADR-0003-cli-command-model.md): Provider-native passthrough and explicit transfer syntax.
- [Codex native transfer bridge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/decisions/ADR-0005-codex-native-import-bridge.md): One-way native API architecture, selection rules, and failure boundaries.

## Distribution

- [Verified shell installer](https://bahadirarda.github.io/rebinder/install.sh): Checksum-verifying native installer for Linux and macOS.
- [Verified PowerShell installer](https://bahadirarda.github.io/rebinder/install.ps1): Checksum-verifying native installer for Windows x86-64.
- [Release system](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/governance/release-system.md): Calendar versions, protected release automation, checksums, and attestations.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/releases): Native binaries, installers, checksums, metadata, and attestations.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/bahadirarda/rebinder): Rust source, schemas, examples, documentation, and delivery workflows.
